heroSummary: Lewisville ISD students start school Wednesday, Aug. 12, 2026. The last day is Friday, May 21, 2027, with early release. Spring Break runs March 15–19, and students return Monday, March 22.
calendarNotes: The official LISD calendar lists 174 instructional days: 84 in the first semester and 90 in the second. customSections.label: What LISD Families Should Know
customSections.content: Four dates on the 2026–27 calendar need more context than a date list alone provides.

groups.label: Important calendar notes
items: December 18: Students and staff have early release. LISD lists dismissal at 1:00 p.m. for high schools, 12:20 p.m. for middle schools, and 11:45 a.m. for elementary schools.
January 4–5: January 4 is a staff day; students return from Winter Break on Tuesday, January 5.
March 29: LISD marks this as its bad weather day. Check the district calendar again if weather closures occur earlier in the year.

May 21: The last day of school is also an early-release day. LISD lists the same 2026–27 dismissal times by school level. Families in early childhood programs should check LISD's school-hours information for program-specific schedules.

customSections.label: About Lewisville ISD
customSections.content: Lewisville ISD serves communities across southern Denton County, including Lewisville, Flower Mound, Highland Village, and The Colony. Districtwide academic dates generally apply across LISD, while testing, athletics, performances, graduation, and other campus events may follow individual school calendars.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Lewisville ISD start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Lewisville ISD starts the 2026–27 school year on Wednesday, August 12, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Lewisville ISD Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 15 through Friday, March 19, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Lewisville ISD Winter Break?
calendarFaqs.a: Lewisville ISD Winter Break starts Monday, December 21, 2026 and runs through Friday, January 1, 2027. Students return on Tuesday, January 5, 2027 after a staff day on January 4.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Lewisville ISD in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day is Friday, May 21, 2027, which is also listed as a student early release day.

calendarFaqs.q: What are the LISD early release dates?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar lists December 18, 2026 and May 21, 2027 as early-release dates. LISD lists dismissal at 1:00 p.m. for high schools, 12:20 p.m. for middle schools, and 11:45 a.m. for elementary schools. Early childhood schedules may differ.

calendarFaqs.q: How many instructional days are in the Lewisville ISD 2026–27 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The Lewisville ISD 2026–27 academic calendar lists 174 instructional days: 84 days in the first semester and 90 days in the second semester.

calendarFaqs.q: What is the LISD bad weather day?
calendarFaqs.a: LISD marks Monday, March 29, 2027 as its bad weather day. Check the official district calendar again if weather closures occur earlier in the school year.

calendarFaqs.q: Can I add the Lewisville ISD calendar to Google Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. MySchoolDates provides a one-time .ics calendar file generated from the reviewed Lewisville ISD calendar records. It can be imported into Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, and Outlook, but it will not automatically update if LISD revises the official calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I check for LISD calendar changes?
calendarFaqs.a: Check the official Lewisville ISD calendar page and your campus announcements for revisions, emergency closures, dismissal-time changes, and school-specific events.

whatsNew.title: Changes from the 2025–26 Calendar
content: Spring Break moves from March 16–20 in 2025–26 to March 15–19 in 2026–27.
The last student day moves from May 22 in 2025–26 to May 21 in 2026–27.
